t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes come in fixed pairs. Specific coloured gnomes lead to either bright forests or dark forests. There is no specific connection between this and the amount of mushrooms in the particular forests however.

vb_textbox.text: The aim is to harvest as many mushrooms as possible. The gnomes come in fixed pairs, with also specific forest type and basket colour for each gnome colour. The colours of the gnomes might sometimes have a correlation with the amount of mushrooms harvested so be mindful of this.
